description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for handling table cell operations within a ProseMirror-based editor, including cell navigation, selection, and attribute manipulation.

methods.name: cellAround
methods.description: Finds the cell around a given resolved position, returning its position or null.

methods.name: cellWrapping
methods.description: Returns the cell node that wraps a given position, or null if none.

methods.name: isInTable
methods.description: Checks if the current selection is within a table.

methods.name: selectionCell
methods.description: Determines the cell position within the current selection.

methods.name: cellNear
methods.description: Finds a nearby cell position relative to a given position.

methods.name: pointsAtCell
methods.description: Checks if a position points at a table cell.

methods.name: moveCellForward
methods.description: Moves the position forward to the next cell.

methods.name: inSameTable
methods.description: Determines if two cell positions are within the same table.

methods.name: findCell
methods.description: Finds the cell rectangle at a given position.

methods.name: colCount
methods.description: Returns the number of columns at a given position.

methods.name: nextCell
methods.description: Finds the next cell in a specified direction.

methods.name: removeColSpan
methods.description: Removes colspan from cell attributes at a specified position.

methods.name: addColSpan
methods.description: Adds colspan to cell attributes at a specified position.

methods.name: columnIsHeader
methods.description: Checks if a column is a header column.

methods.name: getClientX
methods.description: Gets the clientX coordinate from a mouse or touch event.

methods.name: getClientY
methods.description: Gets the clientY coordinate from a mouse or touch event.

methods.name: isTouchEvent
methods.description: Determines if an event is a TouchEvent.
